articles.title: Northwind Group Closes $1B Debt Fund
articles.narrative: Northwind Group has successfully closed its third real estate credit fund, Northwind Debt Fund III (NDF III), with $1 billion in committed capital, significantly exceeding its initial $500 million target. The fund, which primarily focuses on senior loans, has already deployed $1.5 billion across multifamily, condominium, and office-to-residential projects in major U.S. gateway markets. Its investor base includes pension funds, insurance companies, banks, family offices, and ultra-high-net-worth individuals, many of whom are returning investors from Northwind's previous successful funds. The fund is nearly 60% deployed and is expected to reach 90% deployment by the end of 2026, with a strong emphasis on residential properties in supply-constrained markets like New York City.

data_points.notable_features: Fund focuses primarily on senior loans for multifamily, condominium, and office-to-residential properties.
data_points.project_notes: Northwind Debt Fund III (NDF III) closed with $1 billion in committed capital, exceeding its $500 million target. The fund has already originated $1.5 billion in loans and is nearly 60% deployed, targeting 90% deployment by end of 2026. Typical loan sizes are $100 million to $200 million, with about 93% geared toward residential properties.

articles.title: Infinity Collective Tweaks Plans for Miami Beach Project at Former Shvo Site
articles.narrative: Infinity Collective has revised its plans for a mixed-use development in Miami Beach, reducing the number of rental units while increasing office and retail space. The project, located on the former Epicure Gourmet Market site, will now feature 142 rental units, 51,200 square feet of Class A office space, and 45,313 square feet of retail. The Miami Beach Planning Board is set to review the updated proposal.

data_points.notable_features: Adjacent to Lincoln Road, includes a five-story parking garage with 365 spots at 1677 West Avenue.
data_points.project_notes: Site was previously acquired by Infinity Collective for $28.3 million last year through a deed in lieu of foreclosure from Michael Shvo. The site was formerly planned for a six-story office building by Michael Shvo and housed the Epicure Gourmet Market until its demolition.

articles.title: The Plan: At Cobble Hill’s 110 Boerum, No Two Floor Plates Are the Same
articles.narrative: Avdoo, a Brooklyn-based developer, challenged Brent Buck Architects to design a luxury condo project in Cobble Hill where no two floor plates are identical. The resulting six-story, 21-unit building, 110 Boerum Place, features unique floor plans and individual exterior spaces for each residence, aiming to provide the privacy and craftsmanship of a townhouse with comprehensive amenities. The project is 70 percent sold, with move-ins anticipated to begin early next year, reflecting strong local demand for new construction in the neighborhood.

data_points.notable_features: Luxury condo building with no two floor plates exactly the same, offering units ranging from two to five bedrooms. Features over 11,000 square feet of amenities including a gym, spa, children's playroom, party room, on-site parking, and a private courtyard with a waterfall.
data_points.project_notes: The project spans the entire block from Dean Street to Pacific Street. Units still for sale range in price from $4.85 million to $13.5 million.

articles.title: Personal Training Studio LIV Method Takes 12K SF in Meatpacking District
articles.narrative: A luxury personal training and wellness studio, The LIV Method, has signed a 12,028-square-foot lease at 2 Gansevoort Street in Manhattan's Meatpacking District. The new location, set to open in January, will be the studio's third in Manhattan, offering a highly personalized and hospitality-driven experience with fitness, sauna, cold plunge, massage, and IV wellness treatments. The landlord expressed that the studio aligns with their vision for the property, enhancing its appeal as a dynamic destination within the neighborhood.

data_points.address: 2 Gansevoort Street, New York City, NY
data_points.notable_features: Space spans two levels connected by an open staircase; building is also known as 320 West 13th Street and sits adjacent to Corporal John Seravalli Playground.

people.name: Michael Lenchner
people.title: Executive Vice President and Director of Leasing

articles.market_intelligence: The average asking rent for retail space in the area near Washington Street and 14th Street was $333 per square foot during the third quarter of 2026.

articles.title: Forbright Bank Provides $50M for Southern California R&D Campus
articles.narrative: Alta West Partners has secured $49.8 million in bridge financing from Forbright Bank for the Lakeview Innovation Center, a fully leased research and development and office campus in Thousand Oaks, CA. The three-year, floating-rate loan follows Alta West's two-year repositioning of the asset, which resulted in significant net operating income growth through strategic leasing and capital improvements.

data_points.address: 112 Lakeview Canyon Rd, Thousand Oaks, CA
data_points.notable_features: Class A asset with lab space, office and R&D space, dock-high loading capabilities, 20,000 amps of electrical capacity, an Equinox fitness center, a full-service café, a two-story atrium, a pickleball court, and 24-hour security.
data_points.project_notes: Alta West Partners acquired the campus in September 2024 and achieved over 170 percent growth in net operating income through leasing and capital improvements.

articles.title: IPA Arranges Sale of 288-Unit Apartment Complex in Red Oak, Texas
articles.narrative: Institutional Property Advisors (IPA) has facilitated the sale of Ovilla at Legacy Square, a 288-unit apartment complex in Red Oak, Texas. The property, developed by Thompson Realty Capital and Trez Capital, was acquired by Fogelman Properties, which intends to implement capital improvements. This transaction highlights continued investor interest in well-located multifamily assets in the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex.

data_points.address: 241 N Overlook Dr, Red Oak, TX
data_points.notable_features: Amenities include a pool, clubhouse, outdoor grilling and dining stations, and a dog park.

articles.title: Marcus & Millichap Brokers $7.5M Sale of Restaurant Building in Katy, Texas
articles.narrative: Marcus & Millichap has brokered the $7.5 million sale of an 8,753-square-foot restaurant building in Katy, Texas. The property, net-leased to a Brazilian restaurant chain, was sold by a developer to a California-based 1031 exchange investor in an all-cash transaction. The sale price equates to $874.84 per square foot.

articles.title: G&S Fasteners Signs 19,200 SF Industrial Lease in Northwest Houston
articles.narrative: G&S Fasteners, a supplier of industrial and construction equipment, has signed a 19,200-square-foot industrial lease in northwest Houston. The tenant was represented by Oxford Partners, while Stream Realty Partners represented the landlord, a subsidiary of DRA Advisors.

articles.title: Baker Katz Negotiates Five Leases for Einstein Bros. Bagels Totaling 9,548 SF in Greater Houston
articles.narrative: Baker Katz has successfully negotiated five new leases for Einstein Bros. Bagels across the greater Houston area, totaling 9,548 square feet. These new locations are strategically situated in Houston's Garden Oaks district and the suburban communities of Tomball, Spring, Baytown, and Manvel, expanding the bagel chain's presence in the region.

articles.title: Partnership Completes Multifamily Project, Public Park in Dover, New Hampshire
articles.narrative: A partnership between Cathartes and the City of Dover has completed The Truette, a 220-unit multifamily project, and Nebi Park, a 3.5-acre public park, in Dover, New Hampshire's waterfront district. The apartment complex offers a variety of unit types and amenities including a rooftop terrace and coworking spaces, while the park features art installations and a pavilion.

data_points.address: Parking lot, 9 River St, Dover, NH
data_points.notable_features: Includes studio, one-, two-, and three-bedroom units, as well as 2,200-square-foot townhomes. Amenities include a rooftop terrace, coworking spaces, fitness areas, pet-friendly facilities, and an onsite restaurant. Nebi Park features art installations and a 2,300-square-foot pavilion.

articles.title: Mid-America Real Estate Corporation closes sale of grocery-anchored shopping center in Wheaton
articles.narrative: Mid-America Real Estate Corporation's Investment Sales Group has facilitated the sale of Rice Lake Square, a 244,924-square-foot grocery-anchored shopping center in Wheaton, IL. The property, anchored by a high-performing Pete's Fresh Market, was sold by Core Acquisitions to Phillips Edison Company (PECO). The center benefits from its strategic location in an affluent western Chicago suburb, drawing significant traffic from surrounding communities.

data_points.notable_features: Grocery-anchored by Pete's Fresh Market on a long-term lease; located at a dominant retail intersection with 51,000 vehicles per day.

articles.title: A major mixed-use success story in Sugar Land: Why Sugar Land Town Square continues to thrive
articles.narrative: Sugar Land Town Square, a prominent mixed-use development in Sugar Land, TX, is undergoing a $12.5 million revitalization to update its offerings and maintain competitiveness. The improvements, nearing completion, include upgrades to office buildings with new amenities like a café, shared meeting spaces, and a tenant lounge. This reinvestment has already spurred leasing activity, with a Fortune 500 firm signing a significant office lease and new restaurant, retail, and entertainment concepts being introduced. City officials emphasize that the revitalization is crucial for the district to evolve with modern market demands and continue its role as a vital economic and social hub.

data_points.notable_features: Mixed-use district with retail, office, and residential properties; includes a new fitness center and various dining and entertainment options.
data_points.project_notes: Revitalization project for an existing mixed-use district, supported by an incentive program. The district was originally developed over 20 years ago as part of the City’s first public-private partnership.

articles.market_intelligence: Sugar Land Town Square generates the highest taxable value per acre of any property in Fort Bend County, according to an Urban3 study. The district has welcomed 70 million visitors over the past two decades.

articles.title: Brixton Capital acquires 120,522-square-foot grocery-anchored shopping center in Sachse
articles.narrative: Brixton Capital has acquired Oak Grove Plaza, a 120,552-square-foot, grocery-anchored shopping center in Sachse, Texas, from Nuveen. This acquisition marks Brixton Capital's entry into the Texas retail market, complementing its existing multifamily portfolio in the state. The property, anchored by a high-performing Kroger, offers strong patronage for its diverse mix of daily-needs services and medical providers, with potential for value-add development through an additional pad site.

data_points.notable_features: Class A property anchored by a Kroger that has operated on-site for 23 years and performs substantially above chain average. Includes a Kroger gas pad.
data_points.project_notes: Brixton Capital has the opportunity to build out an additional pad on the property.

articles.market_intelligence: The DFW retail market is strong, with an average household income of $128,741 and nearly 17% of the population earning $200,000 or more. The Firewheel trade area, where Oak Grove Plaza is located, is a dominant retail concentration in the northeast quadrant of the metroplex, benefiting from an affluent workforce pushing east from the Plano corporate corridor.

articles.title: 25 E. Washington Wins AIA’s 2026 People’s Choice Award After Establishing Vintage Class-A Building Class Status
articles.narrative: The 25 E. Washington office building in Chicago, IL, has received the AIA's 2026 "People's Choice Award" in the retail and hospitality category, following a $20 million renovation completed in 2025. The extensive redevelopment, highlighted by the creation of The Atrium Club, has repositioned the historic Daniel Burnham-designed property as a model for "Vintage Class A" office space. The project demonstrates how a century-old building can be modernized to offer high-quality amenities, flexibility, and a tenant experience comparable to new Class A properties.

data_points.notable_features: Daniel Burnham-designed historic building, formerly the Marshall Field & Co. Men's Store Annex, featuring The Atrium Club, a 17,000-square-foot tenant amenity center with a 3,000-square-foot open atrium.
data_points.project_notes: The renovation established a new 'Vintage Class A' category for Chicago office buildings, demonstrating how historic properties can be repositioned to offer modern Class A amenities and tenant experience.

articles.title: Appian Investments Acquires 19-Story Greenboro Office Tower
articles.narrative: Appian Investments has acquired Renaissance Plaza, a 19-story office tower in downtown Greensboro, for $22 million. The 287,000-square-foot property, built in 1990, recently underwent nearly $4 million in capital improvements by the seller, Richardson Properties, enhancing its lobby, common areas, and building systems. The tower boasts a strong tenant mix from the financial and legal sectors.

data_points.notable_features: Features a two-story atrium lobby, an attached six-level parking deck with 300 spaces, an on-site cafe, and floor-to-ceiling glass overlooking the city's central business district.
data_points.project_notes: Seller completed nearly $4 million in capital improvements in 2023, including renovations to the lobby and common areas, elevator upgrades, and enhancements to key building systems.

articles.title: Bond Market’s AI Warning Is About Growth, Not Prices
articles.narrative: The bond market recently signaled that concerns over a potential AI debt bust are temporarily outweighing inflation anxieties, as investors sought safety in U.S. Treasurys while AI-linked credit experienced a sell-off. This shift, exemplified by the struggles of AI cloud provider CoreWeave, suggests that financing stress could impede investment and demand within the AI sector. However, the market pricing does not yet indicate an expectation of economy-wide deflation, but rather a potential disinflationary impact concentrated on the debt-funded buildout of AI infrastructure. The article emphasizes that a sustained retreat in financing could reduce demand for data center construction and related supplies, easing some inflationary pressures without necessarily leading to a broader collapse in prices.

articles.title: Newmark Affiliate Arranges $369M Financing for 11 Florida Affordable Housing Properties
articles.narrative: Newmark arranged a $369 million Fannie Mae credit facility for April Housing, a Blackstone portfolio company, to support the long-term preservation of an 11-property affordable housing portfolio across Florida. The financing included both fixed-rate and floating-rate draws, structured as an interest-only facility. The transaction involved navigating the complexities of 24 separate regulatory agreements for the properties.

data_points.project_notes: Financing structured as an interest-only Fannie Mae credit facility, consisting of a $221.4 million fixed-rate draw and a $147.6 million floating-rate draw. A buydown on the fixed-rate portion helped maximize proceeds.

articles.title: Morehouse, Spelman Debut $147M Student Housing Project
articles.narrative: Radnor Property Group, in partnership with Madrone Community Development Foundation, has broken ground on The Den at Eight50 West, a $147 million student housing development in Atlanta's West End. This project, developed in collaboration with Morehouse College and Spelman College, will provide 793 beds across 305 apartment-style units. The development is expected to be ready for occupancy by Fall 2028, offering a blend of community-oriented and independent living spaces with a range of amenities.

data_points.notable_features: Amenities include a 24/7 staffed lobby, outdoor recreation space, fitness room, community lounges, bike storage, dog run, and study rooms.

articles.title: Apollo, UDR Forming $2-Billion Multifamily Joint Venture
articles.narrative: UDR, Inc. and Apollo are forming a new, long-term joint venture to acquire a diversified portfolio of 19 apartment communities totaling 7,059 units, valued at approximately $2.0 billion. Apollo will contribute $1.34 billion in equity for a two-thirds interest, with UDR retaining a one-third interest and continuing to manage the portfolio. This strategic partnership provides UDR with significant equity capital to pursue market opportunities, enhance its wholly-owned portfolio, and strengthen its balance sheet.

data_points.project_notes: Apollo will invest approximately $1.34 billion of equity capital for a two-thirds interest in the JV. UDR retains an option to repurchase Apollo’s interest at an expected 7.00-7.50% fixed return for a finite period starting at the fifth anniversary of closing.

articles.title: Forge Atlanta Developer Admits $19M Accounting Error, Falls Further Behind On Its Loan
articles.narrative: Webstar, the developer behind the ambitious Forge Atlanta project, has admitted to a significant accounting error of nearly $19 million. This misstatement has intensified concerns regarding the company's capacity to secure the necessary financing for the $3.8 billion development, further jeopardizing its progress on the project loan.

data_points.project_notes: Developer admitted to a nearly $19 million accounting error.

articles.title: Trammell Crow Breaks Ground On Office-To-Resi Conversion In Dallas: The DFW Deal Sheet
articles.narrative: Trammell Crow has broken ground on a new project in Dallas, converting an existing office building into a 435-unit multifamily development. The project will feature a mix of market-rate and affordable apartments, addressing the growing demand for diverse housing options in the area.

data_points.project_notes: Includes a mix of market-rate and affordable apartments.

articles.title: Faring Proposes Office, Retail Project On Sunset Strip Car Dealership Site
articles.narrative: Faring has proposed a new five-story mixed-use development on Sunset Boulevard in West Hollywood. The project will feature street-level retail and restaurant space, along with office components and digital signage. This development aims to transform a former car dealership site into a vibrant commercial hub.

data_points.notable_features: Includes digital signage and street-level retail and restaurants.
data_points.project_notes: Proposed on a former car dealership site.

articles.title: Foreclosure Auction Set For Loop Office-To-Residential Conversion
articles.narrative: A foreclosure auction is scheduled for 330 S. Wells St. in Chicago next month, following a judge's ruling that the property's $28.2 million mortgage is in default. The building was previously slated for an office-to-residential conversion.

data_points.project_notes: Property was previously planned for an office-to-residential conversion.

articles.title: Liberty Mutual Plans New Office Project To Consolidate HQ: The Boston Deal Sheet
articles.narrative: Liberty Mutual plans to demolish three existing buildings to construct a 10-story addition to its headquarters in Boston's Back Bay. This development aims to consolidate the insurance company's operations into a single, expanded campus.

data_points.notable_features: 10-story addition to an existing headquarters campus.
data_points.project_notes: Involves the demolition of three existing buildings.
